{{Infobox auto|type=[[Fish]]}}
A '''skate''' is an epic ⭐⭐⭐⭐ [[fish]] caught by [[fishing]] in [[Fishing#Cold saltwater|cold saltwater]]. It cooks into [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], and a [[Fisherman]] buys each one for an [[Obol]].

== Obtaining ==
=== Fishing ===
The skate can be caught in this table.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/minecraft/loot_table/gameplay/fishing/saltwater_cold.json}}</ref> The chances are per cast of a [[Fishing Rod|fishing rod]] and include the junk and treasure rolls.
{| class="wikitable"
! Climate !! Biomes !! Weight !! Per catch (open water) !! Per catch (other water) !! Per catch ({{MCW|Luck of the Sea}} III)
|-
| [[Fishing#Cold saltwater|Cold saltwater]] || Frozen Ocean, Deep Frozen Ocean || 1 of 42 || 2.02% || 2.13% || 2.01%
|}

The same tables are also rolled by the fisherman's house chest in [[Village|villages]] and by the {{MCW|Elder Guardian|elder guardian}}'s drops, using the biome at the chest or where the elder guardian dies.

{{Sources}}

== Usage ==
=== Food ===
Raw fish can be eaten, but it heals nothing: Matcha Flavoured removes [[hunger]], and food only heals through the hearts shown on its tooltip. Cooked, it becomes [[Cooked Large Fish|cooked large fish]], which heals {{Hp|5}}.

=== Cooking ===
{{Cooking|station=Oven|Input=Skate|Output=Cooked Large Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Kindling|Input=Skate|Output=Cooked Large Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}} {{Cooking|station=Mud Kiln|Input=Skate|Output=Charred Fish|note=5 s, 0.35 XP}}

The recipes match any <code>minecraft:salmon</code>, so every large fish gives the same result.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/oven/cooked_salmon.json}}</ref> A [[Mud Kiln]] burns it into [[Charred Fish|charred fish]] instead.

=== Crafting ingredient ===
Because it is a salmon underneath, it can be used wherever a raw salmon is accepted: the [[Green Curry Stock|green curry stock]] recipe takes any cod or salmon.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/recipe/food/crafting/uncooked_green_curry.json}}</ref>

=== Trading ===
The [[Fisherman]] buys 1 caught skate for 1 [[Obol]] once he reaches Master level. Only fish caught by fishing (with the ⭐⭐⭐⭐ line) are accepted.<ref>{{Source|MF_datapack/data/matcha/villager_trade/fisherman/5/skate.json}}</ref>

{{Uses}}

== Angler's Almanac ==
The [[Angler's Almanac]] has an entry for the skate under Cold Saltwater (listed chance 2.4%), unlocked by catching one while the almanac tab is open.<ref>{{Source|MF_resourcepack/assets/minecraft/lang/en_us.json}}</ref> Its description reads:
<blockquote>''A flat relative of rays that glides along the seafloor like an aquatic carpet with somewhere to be.''</blockquote>

== Advancements ==
* '''No More Fish in the Sea''' – catch every fish, including this one. Rewards 10 [[Obol]]s.
* '''Fishmonger''' – sell caught fish to a Fisherman.
